description: Sturmgefahr (Stadtgemeinde Bremerhaven) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The storm hazard map is based on the approach of a hazard matrix, according to which the storm danger increases with increasing storm strengths and storm frequencies. The highest risk of storms therefore exists on areas that are relatively often exposed to comparatively high gust wind speeds. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Storm danger (municipality of Bremerhaven)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Sturmgefahr. The listing shows 2024-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
